notes.title: Nympho Monster Domination launch!
notes.content:
Our newest title is finally here! In Nympho Monster Domination a man filled with pent-up sexual frustration is suddenly summoned to another world as it's would-be-savior. Dominate the hordes of horny monster girls to add to your mythical harem, and maybe while you're at it save the world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36143261/fa2be07f230c0dc0628c7fe52d0c06c6df4b5e6c.png[/img]

The new options we've added that deserve a little explanation are "Voice Overrun" and "Wait for Voice." With Voice Overrun we allow you to choose if you want a voice file to continue playing even after advancing past the original line the voice started on. For example, when Lilim is marveling at what a magnificent male specimen you are, if you choose Voice Overrun then her voice file will continue to play even when you proceed to the next line which is an 'unvoiced character.' 

Wait for Voice affects the Auto-Forward function, normally the auto mode would wait until a voice file finishes playing before advancing. Now that one voice file can span many lines of dialogue disabling the Wait for Voice setting means that the auto mode will advance the page of dialogue regardless if a voice file is playing. 

A third small change we made was to allow the player to advance dialogue by scrolling the mouse wheel, it was a small thing that was requested in our [url=https://discord.gg/eyDMEGH]Discord channel[/url] so if you to have suggestions or requests to improve the game head over and say hello~
